Hadith.1792 - In the narration of Abdullah ibn Sinan, he said:
"Abu Abdullah (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) said to me:
'If there are two Thursdays at the beginning of the month, fast the first of them, for it is better. And if there are two Thursdays at the end of the month, fast the last of them, for it is better.'"
